description: Read SOTW-computed public onchain prices. market=pools (default) reads Uniswap/Raydium/PancakeSwap token pools in USDC (BNB uses Binance-Peg USD Coin). market=derivatives reads Hyperliquid perpetual bid/ask midpoints with original units, source time, spread and depth checks. Instruments are distinct from linked cash securities, bullion benchmarks, indices and official yields. Unavailable prices are null. Set catalog=true to list reviewed contracts without source reads.

symbols.description: Case-sensitive token symbols (PAXG, AAPLx, SLVon) or exact perpetual IDs (xyz:SILVER, xyz:CL, para:10Y).

name: get_onchain_quotes
